---
title: ggtitle
subtitle: Shortcut for setting the plot title (and optional subtitle).
category: Labs
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Equivalent to `labs(title: title, subtitle: subtitle)`.

## Usage

```typst
ggtitle(
  title,
  subtitle: none,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` |  | Plot title drawn above the panel. |
| `subtitle` | `none` | Optional smaller line drawn below the title. |

## Returns

Dictionary tagged `kind: "labs"`, consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/ggtitle-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2),
  (x: 2, y: 4),
  (x: 3, y: 3),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  labs: ggtitle("Quick look", subtitle: "Three points"),
)
```

## See also

[`labs`](labs.qmd), [`xlab`](xlab.qmd), [`ylab`](ylab.qmd).
